Product Sync - Meeting Minutes
Date: Sep 10, 2026
Attendees: Sam Ortiz, Tom Becker, Mia Chen
Note taker: Mia Chen
Decisions
1. Ship ordering in the next release; payments follow in a separate release.
2. Raise the checkout timeout alert threshold to 600 ms.
Discussion
Sam Ortiz reported that weekly active users grew 12% after the loyalty launch. Tom Becker raised concerns about support load during the rollout and asked for a staged release.
Action items
Action | Owner | Due
Staged rollout plan | Tom Becker | Friday
Alert threshold change | Sam Ortiz | Monday
Release notes | Mia Chen | Tuesday
